items.name: LeMaire Lee
items.caption:
Matt and Shane’s Secret Podcast producer LeMaire Lee is putting his own stand-up front and center.
LeMaire Lee performs at Punch Line Houston on December 23, 2026. He also hosts the podcast Panties in the Mouth. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
